svg.title: How OtoDock works
svg.desc: Work reaches one OtoDock server from the dashboard, the phone, schedules and the API. The server runs every Claude Code and Codex session on one of your machines: the compute machine it comes with, an admin remote machine or your own computer. On every machine the same agent works, headless or in a live terminal.
